data.narrative:
AbCellera is a public-stage biotech company founded by Hansen, Lecault, Heyries, Da Costa, Lisaingo, and Petriv. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 3 public peers in the Biotech & Health sector—Recursion Pharmaceuticals, Freenome, and Alto Neuroscience—alongside 8 additional private-stage reference companies.

The peer-median method is the primary applicable approach, anchoring on a median valuation of $1.1B across the 3 same-sector, same-stage comparables. The peer set ranges from $1.0B (Alto Neuroscience) to $1.6B (Recursion Pharmaceuticals). Public-comp anchoring via sector price-to-sales multiples (6.2x median across RXRX, TEM, and ONT.L) cannot be applied owing to the absence of disclosed revenue figures, a common constraint in private company valuation. The triangulated range derived from the single applicable method spans $935M (low) to $1.3B (high), with a central estimate of $1.1B.

Key uncertainties include AbCellera's actual revenue run-rate and margin profile relative to peers, neither of which is available for direct comparison. The limited applicability of multiples-based methods underscores reliance on peer-median positioning. Investors should seek additional disclosure on revenue and cash-burn dynamics to narrow the valuation bandwidth and stress-test positioning against the $1.0B–$1.6B peer range.
